_description: Monsters whose too-low-Slayer refusal names the level, keyed by NPC name; '#' is the monster's Slayer level. Every other Slayer monster refuses with Combat.Slayer's generic line. Zygomite: rsprox captures (rev 243, Zanaris, the level 86 zygomite, 57 Slayer).

byName.Zygomite: You need a Slayer level of # to know how to wound this monster.
